items.example: I take the bus to work.
items.simple: A big, long car for many people. It stops many times on the road.

items.example: My car is outside.
items.simple: It has four wheels. You sit inside and go to places.

items.example: The train is late today.
items.simple: A long line of cars that runs on metal tracks. Many people ride in it.

items.example: Let's take a taxi.
items.simple: A car with a driver. You say where to go, and you pay money.

items.example: I go to the park by bike.
items.simple: It has two wheels. You sit on it and push with your feet.

items.example: The plane leaves at nine.
items.simple: It flies high in the sky and takes people far away.

items.example: I'm at the station now.
items.simple: A place where you wait for a train and get on it.

items.example: The bus stop is over there.
items.simple: A place on the road where a big car stops for people.

items.example: I need a ticket to London.
items.simple: A small paper you buy so you can go on a bus or train.

items.example: One ticket to Ankara, please.
items.simple: You say this to buy one paper to go on a bus or train.

items.example: I go to work by bus.
items.simple: You go to a place in a big car with many people.
items.note: Ulaşım aracında 'a/the' kullanılmaz: by bus, by car, by train.

items.example: I go to the shop on foot.
items.simple: You go to a place with your feet, not in a car.

items.example: I drive to work every day.
items.simple: You sit in a car and make it go where you want.

items.example: I walk to the station.
items.simple: You go places using your feet, one step and then another.

items.example: Get on the bus here.
items.simple: You step up and go inside a bus or a train.
items.note: Taksi ve arabaya binmek için 'get in' kullanılır.

items.example: I get off at the next stop.
items.simple: You step down and go out of a bus or a train.

items.example: Sorry, I'm late. The bus was late.
items.exampleTr: Kusura bakma, geciktim. Otobüs geç geldi.
items.simple: Not on time. You come after the time people wanted you.

items.en: Which bus goes to the centre?
items.example: Excuse me, which bus goes to the centre?
items.simple: You ask this to find the big car that goes to the middle of town.

items.example: How much is a ticket to the airport?
items.simple: You ask this to know how much money the paper costs.

items.example: How long does it take by train?
items.simple: You ask this to know how much time you need to get there.

items.en: The next bus is at ten past five.
items.tr: Bir sonraki otobüs beşi on geçe.
items.example: The next bus is at ten past five.
items.exampleTr: Bir sonraki otobüs beşi on geçe.
items.simple: You say this when the next bus comes at 5:10.
